name: go-modern-guidelines
description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
one_liner: A rulebook that teaches AI coding assistants to write up-to-date Go instead of outdated patterns from old training data.
buyer: This is a free developer aid from JetBrains, not a product to resell. The real buyer is a Go team that wants cleaner AI-written code, and they just install it.
business_use_cases: A Go-heavy engineering team installs it so every AI-generated pull request uses current idioms and needs less cleanup.
A training company points students at it as the reference for modern Go style.
A template for the broader idea: sell 'house style' rule packs for AI agents in other languages or frameworks.

money_ideas.idea: The transferable idea, not this repo: build and sell curated 'agent style guides' for niche stacks (embedded C, legacy Java) where AI output is routinely wrong.

steal_this: Copy the format for a language the big vendors ignore. Package a 'write modern <X>' skill and sell it to teams drowning in outdated AI code.
